parts:
I don't know
what they're after.

Feels like there's
something much bigger
behind all this.

No, Kondo said
he would do it

So those two were
innocent after all?

We're heading back.
We'll talk there.

He saw us cut loose
at that restaurant.

That old man was
talking about dreams.

I'd better let him out
right away!

Amanto pressure on
the shogunate worries me.

I'll break your glasses!
Then you'll have
no character at all!

Strawberry milk,
choc omelet in sauce...

I was just about
to dig in!

Who can do
something like that?

Empty your mind,
and hunger is a joy!

A Daraku or two?
Who cares?

Gah! Old hag!
Quit barging in!

Landlady or not,
I'm a professional.

If it's work,
you'll pay my fee!

No work?
Then go home, hag.

...
Can't pay what
I haven't got.

I sit here listening,
and you say what you like!

Fine! A Gin Tama duel,
you old hag!

I was just playing
in my imagination.

What about getting rich
with Dragon Tama?

I told you!
This is MY house!

Want me to bring
the property deed?

Why would I ask
someone like you...

Pay the rent
you owe me already!

Then go find a job,
you blockhead!

Show me you're trying
to pay, or you're
out of here!

If I win, you pay
all the rent you owe!

Huh? Were you dreaming
with your eyes open?

We'll starve
at this rate! Starve!

That last incident
ruined our reputation...

Right. There were two
of those creatures...
I mean, people.

Kagura, where did
you learn those words?

Otose, could you
wait a little longer?

Now, as promised,
the rent can wait.

How many times?!
I can't pay what I lack!

To think I lost
to this freeloader...

I said you pay
the rent if I win.

Never said a thing
about losing, did I?

Now, pay up.
Every last coin.

How many times,
you senile hag?

Say what you like.
I can't pay
what I lack.

You'll pay for this,
you old hag!

Gin, let's just
do as she says.

Hey, Zura!
I know you're in here!

What the hell
are you doing?

I thought you were
acting suspicious...

An Amanto prince
meeting face-to-face
with a Joui rebel...

Don't tell me this is
just trading Gin Tama.

That grave face,
and all that blather!

Let's settle this
with a Gin Tama duel!

Look! There's an orb
right there!

Team up with that idiot.
If I win...

I merely came here
for a proper
business transaction!

They offered to buy
my collection for
fifty percent over market!

This is merely
a gathering to
trade Gin Tama.

...Gintoki. I told you
not to get involved.

I still cannot
tell you. No...

No... I cannot
drag you into this!

Actually, of course
he would be here...

Look, over there...
Prince Hata's here too.

He said you two are
stuck with each other.
But...

...that bond is the
most precious thing
in his life!

As you know, Katsura,
Gin is an idiot!

Yes, a huge idiot!
A total idiot!

He can't turn away
from your troubles...
A friend's troubles!

But I cannot
speak of it yet.

I do not gather
Gin Tama for greed
or wicked schemes.

Fine. A promise
is a promise.
Do what you want.

But before we go,
one last question,
Zura.

This really isn't
anything shady...
is it?

I win. As promised,
you will stop
prying any further.

I do not gather
Gin Tama for greed
or wicked schemes.

A shady deal
with this idiot...?

Sure, he's an
annoying Zura, but...

He's never been
able to lie.

Next time, you buy me
matcha cream zenzai.

Don't tell me
to cut back on sweets.
They're my reason to live!

Serves you right
for being greedy!

I did let slip
that Joui rebels
gather here...

I only said it to
help old man Hiraga
get away...

He tricked us!
Said Gin Tama inquiries
were forbidden!

We're letting the
big fish go. Can't
send them home empty-handed.

A-again!
You called me an idiot!

I only came here
to sell Gin Tama!
What a calamity!

A rare cicada creature
from Planet Alpha
was being sold online.

I simply had
to have it.

If I could do that,
I wouldn't be in
this predicament!

You just said
I should leave...

His reckless spending
led to his allowance
being cut last month.

Everything I do
is for this country!

Gin Tama are
not mere toys.

If you insist
on getting involved...

Just use your allowance.
You're rich.

They were looking
into Gin Tama, too.

Gin! This is bad!
If they storm in now,
Katsura's done for!

Maybe they heard
about tonight's deal
somewhere...

Can't be helped.
We made that huge
scene in the place.

I'd fire us too
if I owned it.

What? Want to get
fired from here, too?
Just say the word.

No, I don't
care about that.

If I've got time
to worry about them...

I'd rather choose
not to think at all.

Old hag, you've
got sharp ears!

Money makes
the world go round...

I've got it!
This is it, Shinpachi!

This is what's
been bugging me!

What I've been
worrying about
all this time...

Not one grain
of rice left.

At this rate,
we'll really starve...

Quiet, Shinpachi!
You're making my
stomach hurt!

We're just back
where we started.

I think we're
pretty much there
already.

Since we're here,
let's have Otose
feed us!

You threw away
a perfectly good job!

How will you
pay the rent?!

You can say that
once some money's
ever come YOUR way!

Or I'll really
throw you out!

You've got some nerve
asking for that
after all this!!

Man... I thought
we wouldn't have to
worry about food for a while.

All you've said
this whole time
is 'yeah'...!

Are you king
of Planet Yeah?!

There you go,
getting defiant again...

...They said he
was responsible
for supervising us.

Actually... more like
we got thrown out
of our new home...

Mr. Hiraga seemed
to be hiding
something, right?

Then what could it be?
...No space pirates
showed up this time...

Hmm... Then
what could it be?

...No, Kagura.
That's exactly
why it's a problem...

I've seen that
robot somewhere
before...

I don't want
his help either!

Maybe we could
have won if we
fought together...

I'm not doing this
to save your ass.

Well, much as
I hate to...

I know I've seen
it somewhere...

That old man
built this robot.

I just remembered
something REALLY
important!

Hey, can you
hear me out?

Of course!
It matters when
explaining who I am!

The present exists
because of the past.
That is history.

My past led
to my current job.

Is that any way
for a cop to talk?

I didn't stick
my nose in
because I wanted to.

Don't be stupid!
I've got no police powers!

Besides, there's
no money in it!

You can turn a
blind eye to crime?

As a citizen,
I'll at least
tell you this.

Well, I'd better
get going.
I've got work tonight.

Huh, you're right.
Maybe an illusion?

Well, I'm really
off now. See ya!

Hey! We lost
because of you!

I'd love to
smash it, but...

Guess I have no
choice this once...

Idiot! What
are you talking about?!

No! My attacks
took it down!

Yes, but how
did you know?

Who is this
old man, anyway?

W-what?
Why shout
all of a sudden?

What is it?
Now I want to know!

Hey! Why do I
have to hear
your life story?!

I don't want
to hear it either!

Says you.
All those cases
you've...

Then get dragged
into this one, too.

Did you do that
on purpose to let
the old man escape?!

Not my fault!
It's YOUR fault!
And what a thing to say!

...Well, I'd better
head back and fix

Please don't say that!
Let me walk
you home!!

She's caught by
some strange robot.

No time to hesitate.
What will you do?

Easy, now.
Why not say you
both beat it?

No, thank you.
I can go home alone.

Then take off
that sleep mask,
you idiot!

What are you
doing, damn it?!

being useful
tools is no problem.

If you're fine
with it, Kondo,
we'll obey.

Then I'll go
on a little patrol.

No. He refuses
to say a word.

Even the old man
looked unhappy.

No point
worrying about
that, is there?

Oops. Seeing you,
Hijikata, I just...

Why do you
think that, Hijikata?

I see.
You have a point.

Why not? I need
a change of pace, too.
